CSE - Diagnose Script.vi

Owning Palette: CSE Advanced VIs

The VI returns names of variables and functions referenced in a parsed CSE Script.

Click the parameters for more information

 

CSE RefNum is a reference number for a CSE instance that contains a parsed CSE script. CSE - Parse Script.vi returns a value that can be wired directly to this terminal.
Items specifies what names the VI is to return:

0VariablesThe VI returns variable names. It's default value.
1FunctionsThe VI returns function names (both FuncVI and FastFunc functions).
2FuncVI functionsThe VI returns names of FuncVI functions only.
3FastFunc functionsThe VI returns names of FastFunc functions only.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
sort (F) specifies whether an output array of names need be sorted. If it is TRUE, elements in Array of Items are sorted in alphabetical case-insensitive order. Default value is FALSE.
dup CSE RefNum is a flow-through parameter with the same value as CSE RefNum.
Array of Items returns names of variables or functions requested. The array doesn't contain duplicate elements.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
